judgment.notes: L1 matches N009. N005's normal form is applied to the time-constant smooth f_n and smooth mean-zero F_n, with F_n(t_n)=0 and F_n'=Bop(f_n,f_n)/2. Symmetry of Jop gives the Cop term with coefficient -1/6. For N006, [t_n,t] lies in [0,infinity), has length at most tau<=1, and all static slots are mean-zero: use sigma=gamma on w and sigma=0 on the three L2 difference terms. The supplied bounded extension covers nonsmooth w. H002 supplies both exponent ranges. N005's negative-norm bound applies because Y_n and Y_n' have zero mean.
